verdict.rationale: Highnote lets you configure rule-based logic that runs on its own without manual intervention. Spend rules and velocity controls "automate logic on authorizations" and are evaluated at every authorization. Program-level rules apply across all cards, cards close automatically when a workflow ends, and webhooks deliver configured events for downstream reactions. However, these are narrow, payment-specific policy automations rather than general user-defined background automations, so anything beyond authorization rules requires the user's own systems listening to webhooks. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation or workflow builder, scheduled or triggered background jobs beyond authorization-time rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
